lyrics:
[intro]
[verse]
Bare feet on the cooling sand
A salt-kissed breeze across the land
The orange glow is fading slow
Watching where the shadows go
[chorus]
Caught in this golden hour haze
Lost in the rhythm of these days
With the ocean humming a melody
It's just the tide and you and me
[verse]
The pier lights flicker one by one
We're waving goodbye to the sinking sun
Time doesn't matter, it slows down here
With every whisper that I hear
[chorus]
Caught in this golden hour haze
Lost in the rhythm of these days
With the ocean humming a melody
It's just the tide and you and me
[bridge]
Waves roll in and pull away
Washing out the heavy day
Everything feels right again
Like a long-lost summer friend
[chorus]
Caught in this golden hour haze
Lost in the rhythm of these days
With the ocean humming a melody
It's just the tide and you and me
[outro]
